firstPlayerRule: Choose the most chill player as host. The host asks one player to choose a number; then everyone draws simultaneously, so there is no opening turn to assign.
clarifications: The host receives a card and keeps it unseen until play.
All players transform a doodle at the same time during each timed round.

internalEvidence: Inspected the publisher-authored English booklet from the archive. Page 2 assigns the most chill player as host; page 4 has the host select a number chooser, and page 5 has all players reveal and draw simultaneously. The ©2018 Big G Creative credits and drawing components match inventory BGG 256536. SHA-256: 6783fe07fa4f7d21d29483d06264cf904e329fde924a5df23cb8296fa8a91bd5.
